title: huperzia drummondii
intro: Huperzia drummondii, commonly known as Drummond's spleenwort, is a species of liverwort in the family Huperziaceae. It is a vascular plant, more specifically a type of cryptogam, that has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. Huperzia drummondii is valued for its health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, which may help to protect against age-related cognitive decline and neurodegenerative diseases. The bioactive constituents of Huperzia drummondii include huperzine A, a potent inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase, as well as other compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and neuroprotection.
